title: POWERFUL 2AM TO 3AM MID-NIGHT PRAYERS TO BREAK GENERATIONAL CURSES
text: Beloved in Christ, there are hours that heaven recognizes as strategic, and there are times when darkness seeks to prevail. Between 2:00 a.m. and 3:00 a.m., destinies are often contested, witches gather, sorcerers conspire, and evil altars seek to speak. But the word of God declares in Job 5:12, he disappointeth the devices of the crafty so that their hands cannot perform their enterprise. Tonight we have gathered in the name of Jesus to scatter the works of darkness to overturn the plots of hell and to enforce the victory of the cross. Let me remind you Psalm 91:es 5-6 declares, "Thou shalt not be afraid for the terror by night, nor for the arrow that flyth by day, nor for the pestilence that walketh in darkness, nor for the destruction that wasted at noon day." That means there are terrors that walk at night, arrows that fly, pestilences that move in darkness, but those who dwell in the secret place of the most high are exempted. Tonight I prophesy your exemption. I decree and declare every terror programmed against you in the night, it returns to send. Every arrow fashioned against your destiny, it is broken. Every pestilence projected against your family, it is arrested by fire. No destruction shall waste your life at noonday. No calamity shall overtake your household. Lift your voice and declare. By the power of the blood of Jesus, I cancel every evil agenda of the night. By the authority of scripture, I nullify enchantments. I silence divination. I destroy satanic ordinances. Every altar speaking my name in the midnight catch fire now. Every priest making incantations against my rising collapse by fire. Exodus 12:12 says, "For I will pass through the land of Egypt this night and will smite all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, and against all the gods of Egypt, I will execute judgment. I am the Lord." That night, God judge the gods of Egypt. Hear me. Tonight, God will judge the gods of your village. God will judge the gods of your father's house. God will judge the altars of poverty, delay, baroness, and stagnation. I decree, every thaith, the spirit of God. I am lifting men out of peace. I am breaking cycles that have lasted for generations. Every altar of poverty break, every spirit of lack scatter, every financial cage open, resources are released, helpers are stand, opportunities locate you over your family. Now lift your voice in holy anger, pray by the blood of Jesus, every ancestral gate resisting my advancement, break every territorial gate resisting my family, scatter every demonic door open for affliction, I shut you forever. Therefore, I stand as a prophetic voice and decree. No weapon of witchcraft, no weapon of monitoring spirits, no weapon of affliction will prosper against you. I condemn every tongue speaking against your marriage. I condemn every tongue speaking against your finances. I condemn every tongue speaking against your health.
